title: DR-20b: by-reference Add proposals not lifetime-checked
description: Refines DR-20 (mimid-1wgh.4.56). With the Skip policy on the group, a KeyPackage in an Add proposal SENT BY ANOTHER MEMBER is not lifetime-checked when our own Commit includes it by reference. Readings: (a) treat as a received leaf (RFC 9420 §7.3 RECOMMENDED) and skip; (b) treat as a leaf we send (MUST) and check. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-17: (a). Our own Member::commit adds are still checked (KeyPackageIn::validate).
